## Reference

`POST /api/v1/tasks/{taskId}/retry`

Re-queues a failed or cancelled task with the same parameters.

### Parameters

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `taskId` | path | string | yes | Task ID |

### Responses

| Status | Description |
|---|---|
| `202` | Task re-queued |
| `404` | Not found |
| `409` | Task is not in a retryable state |

### Example request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.bitbybit.dev/api/v1/tasks/{taskId}/retry" \
  -H "x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY"
```

Authentication: send your key in the `x-api-key` header. The full machine-readable specification is at [openapi.json](https://learn.bitbybit.dev/openapi.json).
